full_judgment:
Surendra Kumar Sinha, CJ: This review petition is directed from a o judgment of this court in its appellate forum By the impugned judgment this Court set aside the judgment of the high Court Division decreeing the Suit for specific performance and also quashed the proceeding in Title Suit No.279 of 1999. This relates to a house at Gulshan of plot No. 6, Block No. NW(H) 159, Gulshan Avenue, Dhaka. 

 3. This court on a thorough examination of the materials on record came to a definite finding that admittedly Mrs. Inge Flatz was the owner of the house who died before the institution of the suit and the petitioner had also admitted this fact. If the original owner died before the day of filing of the suit the institution of the suit itself though her attorney is a nullity and the court could not pass a decree having realizing this aspect of the matter Mr. Rokanuddin Mahmud opted not to press the petition on merit and submits that the some findings and observations made by this court should be expunged for ends of justice otherwise the petitioner might be subjected to harassment.
